CSV-121.label: R
CSV-121.reason: Direct functional overlap. Both reports describe `CSVParser`/header initialization failing because empty header names are treated as real names and then flagged as duplicates. The current bug is specifically about `CSVFormat.EXCEL.withHeader()` on `A,B,C,,` and the same empty-header duplicate-name mechanism is the root cause.

CSV-120.label: I
CSV-120.reason: This is about `CSVPrinter` support for `withHeader`, which is a different subsystem and mechanism (printing vs parsing/header validation). It offers little diagnostic value for locating the parser-side empty-header handling bug.

CSV-122.label: P
CSV-122.reason: Same general header-processing area in `commons-csv`, but the failure mode is different: `nullString`/empty string interaction causing a `NullPointerException`, not duplicate empty header names. It provides regional context around header/value normalization logic, but not the same faulty mechanism.
